sloka: बहवः पार्थिवा राम भयार्तैर्ऋषिभिः पुरा ।अभयं याचिता वीर त्रातारं न च विद्महे ।। ७.६१.२३ ॥
transliteration: bahavaḥ pārthivā rāma bhayārtairṛṣibhiḥ purā ।abhayaṁ yācitā vīra trātāraṁ na ca vidmahe ।। 7.61.23 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, many kings were formerly implored for protection by fear-stricken sages, but we do not know of any true protector.
